items.title: Nvidia stock extends $2.7 trillion rout as SEC probe reportedly investigates its accounting
items.summary: Nvidia's record sell-off deepened as Reuters reported that SEC investigators are examining its accounting.

items.title: Trump critiques Jensen Huang's replacement as he wades deeper into Nvidia turmoil
items.summary: President Trump on Friday offered a defense of ousted Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang, but — perhaps more significantly — criticized the new leadership of the chipmaker.

items.title: Market Hang: AI Reset? Anthropic's Outlook, Amodei's Future, and Who Could Dethrone NVIDIA?
items.summary:
The Market Hang panel discusses how investors should approach the Anthropic (ANT) IPO, whether Dario Amodei is still the right person to lead the publicly traded company, and whether NVIDIA (NVDA) can maintain its position at the top of the AI industry.

Today's panel features Barron's reporter Jacob Sonenshine, The Technology Letter's Tiernan Ray, Epistrophy Capital Research Chief Market Strategist Cory Johnson, and Laffer Tengler Investments CEO and Chief Investment Officer Nancy Tengler.

items.title: Trump on Jensen Huang: 'We're a country of second chances'
items.summary: President Trump told reporters that former Nvidia (NVDA) CEO Jensen Huang should be given a second chance and allowed to return to the company.

items.title: Is today's market showing warning signs of a 2000 bubble?
items.summary:
Host Mark Malek, Siebert Financial's chief investment officer, and his panel of experts weigh in on whether the market is showing signs of a 2000 bubble.

Today's panel includes Raymond James Investment Management Chief Market Strategist Matt Orton, Yahoo Finance Senior Autos Reporter Pras Subramanian, The Wall Street Skinny Co-Founder Kristen Kelly, and Clocktower Group Chief Market Strategist Eric Wallerstein.

items.title: Sozzi: Anthropic’s IPO Surges; Is AMD’s Pullback a Buy?
items.summary:
Yahoo Finance Executive Editor Brian Sozzi breaks down the biggest stories to kick off the trading day, including the performance of Anthropic (ANT)’s IPO, whether AMD (AMD)’s pullback presents a buying opportunity, and Gap (GAP)’s fall earnings warning.

Sozzi then sits down with former Bridgewater (BWB) Associates Chief Investment Strategist Rebecca Patterson and former BNY (BNY) Wealth Management CEO Catherine Keating to discuss their new book, Investment Wisdom, and how its lessons can help friends and loved ones navigate investing.

items.title: Has AI's honeymoon ended on Wall Street?
items.summary: Although the AI industry has been the darling of Wall Street for years, the sector now makes investors wince as it reckons with a wave of concerns over dizzying spending and its promise to make the technology profitable.But as spending has ballooned, so has debt -- and profits have yet to match.

items.title: The S&P 500 Has More Than Tripled in 10 Years, Even After Its Latest Pullback. Here’s What $1,000 in VOO Could Have Become.
items.summary: A host of concerns are creating the perfect storm right now, harming market sentiment.
